title: Canal+ Application Updates and Google Cloud Partnership
description: Canal+, a French television channel, has recently made changes to its application and partnered with Google Cloud.

sources.title: Canal+ modifie son application, voici ce qui va changer pour les utilisateurs !
Canal+ confie sa créativité et ses algorithmes à Google Cloud dès juin 2026
L’application Canal+ s’enrichit de plusieurs nouveautés

sections.heading: Application Changes
paragraphs: According to Journal du Geek, Canal+ has modified its application, bringing changes for users.

sections.heading: Google Cloud Partnership
paragraphs: Lavoixdefrance.fr reports that Canal+ has entrusted its creativity and algorithms to Google Cloud starting from June 2026.

sections.heading: New Features
paragraphs: Univers Freebox mentions that the Canal+ application has been enriched with several new features.

faq.q: What has Canal+ changed in its application?
faq.a: Journal du Geek states that Canal+ has made modifications to its application, affecting user experience.

faq.q: When did Canal+ start partnering with Google Cloud?
faq.a: Lavoixdefrance.fr reports that the partnership with Google Cloud began in June 2026.

faq.q: What new features have been added to the Canal+ application?
faq.a: Univers Freebox mentions several new features have been introduced to the Canal+ application.
